text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what, what, what!? My body suddenly 
feels all warm and fuzzy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's not just power welling up, it's like 
the usual ordinary me has become a 
slightly super ordinary me...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Could this be thanks to the Three 
Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All riiight! Time to run with everything 
I've got~!
